recorded.prompt:q-any:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-any:a: 'Needs all of them: one such row per parent' is a different rule from 'any'.
recorded.prompt:q-any:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-any:c: The row uses t - L, with L the lag ('0 here'). Using t - 1 imposes a one-year lag.
recorded.prompt:q-any:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-any:d: This is the 'needs P024' single-parent row. 'Any' needs one row whose right side sums both parents.
recorded.prompt:q-together:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-together:a: 'Tying the started sums is not enough' to make them start in the same year.
recorded.prompt:q-together:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-together:b: 'A member's start variable for a year outside T_B ... is fixed to 0'.
recorded.prompt:q-together:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-together:c: =3 forces all three in. A bundle is 'funded whole or not at all', and 'nothing' must stay allowed.

recorded.outcome:q-lag:b: 'none of these problems makes the model infeasible'.

recorded.outcome:q-lag:c: 'the child's needs rows force it to 0 in every year'.
